Well appointed and friendly service
Sep 2026 • Family
Although this place may not be an international brand, I was immediately as ease when I entered the spacious, tastefully decorated lobby and met with friendly and helpful staffs. The breakfast was good - even with a limited selection. Too bad that the weather was really bad throughout the stay, but the view would have been great if the weather was good. Interior and the hallways are also well appointed. I hope that they can maintain the property well.

Excellent restaurant, even better service
Jul 2025 • Couples
Had a really nice dinner here last night. We walked out of the centre of the town in the rain and found this restaurant after reading such excellent reviews online. We were not disappointed. Our waiter who I think was the manager of the restaurant (think his name was Tuan) was extremely welcoming and attentive to us. The food was excellent, we had the beef black pepper and the chicken curry. Also the creme brulee was excellent. It was our one year anniversary and Tuan helped me surprise my wife with her favourite cocktail and a nice desert. Highly recommend!
